newsitem.title: MEXICO: Santander offers Invermexico shareholders 49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Santander offers Invermexico shareholders 49 pct.

text.p: Spain's Banco Santander said on Wednesday it would offer shareholders of Grupo Financiero Invermexico, which it is taking over, shares giving control up to 49 percent of the financial group.
"With the aim of increasing its domestic shareholder base, (Santander) will offer all shareholders of Invermexico shares which will allow them to own up to 49 percent" of the group, Santander said.

It said the price of the shares would be similar to the price Santander pays for subscribing shares issued as part of a capital increase being carried out by Banco Mexicano, Invermexico's troubled banking unit.
Santander said last month it would take over Invermexico in return for contributing the lion's share of a huge capital injection to save Mexicano, Mexico's fourth biggest bank.
